criteria.requirement: Build charset_normalizer.atomic.normalize_file_atomic on the delivered strict transcode API. Bound source reads, detect actual text, complete target encoding before touching destination and atomically publish a same-directory temporary file. Default in-place or explicit separate output, preserve existing target mode/new-file private mode, reject symlink paths and clean only owned temporary files on encoding/write/replace failures. Source and old target bytes must survive failures; report actual written bytes/loss count, keep default APIs read-only and do not claim directory crash durability.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
